hero.heading: Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu
hero.subheading: Small-town Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in the Pallars Sobirà. Train respect, effort and community on the mats in Sort.

escola.heading: The school
escola.intro: Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu is Sort's BJJ school, open to adults and kids. We train at a village pace: close-knit, demanding when it matters, no rush.

values.title: Respect
values.desc: On the mats everyone is equal, from white belt to black belt.

values.title: Effort
values.desc: Progress comes from consistency, not natural talent.

values.title: Community
values.desc: A training family, on and off the mats.

instructor.heading: The instructor
instructor.name: Pablo
instructor.bio: Pablo runs Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu with the goal of bringing high-level Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu to the Pallars, for adults and kids.
instructor.lineageText: Pablo trained at Ases Jiu-Jitsu (València) under Ezekiel Zayas, a black belt since 2010, founder of Ases Jiu-Jitsu and technical director of Team Ganbaru. Zayas is a multiple-time IBJJF black belt European champion and international referee.

horaris.heading: Schedule
horaris.note: All classes take place at the Poliesportiu Municipal de Sort.

camps.heading: Camps
camps.intro: Every summer we run the Ganbaru Camp in Sort — a weekend of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu immersion combined with mountain activities in the Pallars. Coached training sessions, a great team atmosphere and the activities that make our setting special, like rafting on the Noguera Pallaresa river. Open to practitioners of all levels.

camp2026.title: Ganbaru Camp 2026
camp2026.body: 5, 6 & 7 June · Sort (Catalan Pyrenees). Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and rafting.

detail.subtitle: 5, 6 & 7 June 2026 · Sort (Catalan Pyrenees)
detail.story: The first edition of the Ganbaru Camp brought together Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu practitioners for a weekend of training and mountains in Sort. Three days combining coached mat sessions with outdoor activities like rafting on the Noguera Pallaresa, in the unbeatable setting of the Pallars. Good jiu-jitsu, good company and our home mountains.
detail.galleryNote: More photos soon. Meanwhile, on Instagram @muntanyabjj.

guies.heading: Guides
guies.intro: Here you'll find the school's reference material, for students and families. It's a complement to in-person classes, not a substitute: the best way to learn BJJ is always on the mats.

manual.title: BJJ Technical Manual
manual.description: Submission mechanics, escapes, takedowns and positions, with illustrations and belt-level legality notes.

competition.title: Competition Guide
competition.description: IBJJF scoring, penalties, techniques allowed per belt, and a basic competition glossary.

guies.moreText: For example, a guide for families: what a kid needs to get started, what a gi is, and how the kids' belt system works.

sections.heading: What data we process and why
paragraphs: This website has no forms or user accounts. We only process the data you voluntarily give us when contacting us by WhatsApp or email (name, phone number, email and the information you include in your message), for these purposes:

sections.heading: Legal basis
list: Enquiries: your consent when you contact us (GDPR art. 6.1.a).
Enrolment: taking pre-contractual steps and performing the service you request (GDPR art. 6.1.b).

sections.heading: Minors
paragraphs: If the enrolment is for a child under 14, it must be done by their parent or legal guardian, who provides the data and gives consent.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiry data is kept for as long as needed to answer it. Enrolled students' data is kept for the duration of the relationship and afterwards for the periods required by law.

sections.heading: Recipients and international transfers
paragraphs: We don't share your data with third parties except where legally required. By using WhatsApp (Meta Platforms) and Gmail (Google), these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area; both companies are certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the European Commission recognises as an adequate safeguard.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to {{EMAIL}}. If you believe we haven't properly handled your request, you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, https://www.aepd.es).

cookies.title: Cookie policy
paragraphs: This website doesn't use any cookies of its own: it has no active forms, user accounts, or analytics or advertising tools.

Some pages load resources from other providers needed for the site to display correctly: fonts (Google Fonts) and the embedded location map (OpenStreetMap). These requests don't install any cookie on your device, but they do involve a technical connection to those providers' servers, which receive your IP address as with any request on the internet.
Since we don't use cookies of any kind, your consent isn't required. You can manage or block these requests from your browser settings if you prefer.
